title: Horizon Implementation Day: Finding opportunities and submitting a proposal in Horizon Europe (September 2026)
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: The autumn 2026 edition of the Commission's starting session for applicants: how Horizon Europe is organised, how to find calls and partners in the Funding & Tenders Portal, and how proposals are written, submitted and evaluated.
covers: A general overview of Horizon Europe
Searching for calls and partners in the Funding & Tenders Portal
The proposal template, basic submission principles and the evaluation criteria, including the Commission's position on using AI tools to write proposals
materials: Video recording, agenda and presentation slides for each session
why: It is the most up-to-date official starting point for a team preparing a Horizon Europe proposal for the 2027 calls. Watching the evaluation part before drafting helps write each section against the criteria experts actually score.
source_name: European Commission · Horizon Europe events and webinars

chapters: Searching for calls and partners in the Funding & Tenders Portal
Submission and evaluation: proposal template, basic principles, evaluation criteria
Using AI tools when writing a proposal
